narrative.overview:
KR Homebase looks like a well-kept records room: a deep navy frame (title bar and left menu) holds pale, ruled work surfaces where the firm's contacts, time and money are kept. Everything inside the frame is a ledger, a card or a form, set close together with hairline borders and almost no shadow. The look comes from order and density, not decoration.

The screens are dense on purpose. People spend whole days here with several clients open, so the system saves height before width, keeps labels on the same line as their fields, and uses 13px body text with 11px small print. Color carries meaning: navy is the frame and the main action, warm camel marks the current tab and the eyebrow over a title, slate heads every table, and red, orange and green appear only for state.

Every value a user may change (colors, padding, sizes) is a `--kr-theme-*` token, set on the theme scope `[data-kr-theme-scope="krhomebase"]`, never on `:root`. A saved user theme overrides the same tokens, so a component that hard-codes a color breaks the user's theme.
keyCharacteristics: Navy frame (title bar and left menu), light work surface inside.
Dense: 13px body, 2px to 10px gaps (3px the default between a label and its field), 22px to 28px controls, rows of data about 20px with 1px cell padding (the Density Contract).
Flat surfaces with hairline borders; shadows only for things that float.
Uppercase, letter-spaced labels on slate table headings and camel eyebrows.
Every color and padding is a user-configurable theme token.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: Never write a color into a component when a `--kr-theme-*` token names it. Users can change these values, so a hard-coded color is a bug.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Red, orange, green and amber mean state. They never decorate.

rules.name: The Small and Bold Rule
rules.body: Body text stays at 13px and small print at 10px to 12px. Make things stand out with weight (700 to 850) and uppercase tracking, not with bigger type.

rules.name: The Login Exception Rule
rules.body: Black Mango, DM Serif Display and Geist belong to the sign-in card (Chalk Denim tokens in `styles/chalk-denim.css`). Do not use them inside the application frame.

rules.name: The Height Budget Rule
rules.body: Screens run out of height before width. Every extra line in a form is a row someone scrolls past.

rules.name: The Density Contract
rules.body: Tight means dense, with little vertical padding (the requester, Nov 12, 2026). Spacing scale 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 10px; 3px default gap-x; rows of data like the Client Accounting register (10pt, leading-tight, 1px cell padding, about 20px a row); fields 22px to 26px, buttons 24px to 28px; card padding 6px to 8px (10px at most). 'Generous' or 'comfortable' means one step up this scale, never more. Density setting 0.7. Full tables: DESIGN.md, Layout. "Usability", "readability" and "accessibility" do not license more space: in KR Homebase usability means dense (PRODUCT.md, "Accessibility: usability first").

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow unless it floats over something else.

rules.name: Intended: The camel eyebrow
rules.body: The small uppercase Warm Camel label above a module title (module header, module placeholder, create dialogs) stays. It names the area the screen belongs to.

rules.name: Intended: The rainbow spinner
rules.body: `RainbowBusySpinner` is the busy signal everywhere, including while content loads. Skeleton placeholders are not used.

rules.name: Intended: Fluid titles
rules.body: The application title (clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 30px)) and the module title (clamp(19px, 2.1vw, 28px)) scale with the window. Body, small and label sizes stay fixed.

rules.name: Intended: Text glyph icons
rules.body: The ⚙, × and ✓ in the ledger settings, close and copy buttons stay until an icon set replaces them. New icons use `KRHomebaseIcons.<Name>`, the one place for icons; an emoji is not an icon.

rules.name: Intended: The disclosure chevron
rules.body: Anything that folds open shows `KRHomebaseIcons.Chevron`, pointing down while folded and turned over (rotate-180, 160ms) when open.

dos: Do read every color and padding from a `--kr-theme-*` token, and add the token to `styles/theme.css` first when it is missing.
Do right-align amount and number columns; Raleway's figures are lining but not fixed-width.
Do keep body text at 13px and small print at 10px to 12px, and build hierarchy with weight and uppercase tracking.
Do head every ledger with the Ledger Slate row in uppercase, tracked 11px text.
Do mark the active tab with the 3px Warm Camel underline and the selected menu row with Active Blue.
Do check every screen at 390px, 768px and 1280px, and fit a repeated form in 1280 by 720.
Do use `U6ConfirmationDialog` and the rainbow spinner for confirmations and busy states.
donts: Don't use `rounded-lg`, `rounded-xl` or larger on cards, buttons, fields or dialogs.
Don't hard-code a color that a token names.
Don't put shadows on surfaces that do not float.
Don't use red, orange, green or amber for decoration.
Don't use the login fonts (Black Mango, DM Serif Display, Geist) inside the application frame.
Don't use the Communications dark set outside Communications.
Don't use `py-3`, `gap-4`, `space-y-4` or larger, or a field or button taller than 30px, inside the frame.
